name: Threshold
author: Erin Carter
description: An unlit room read in negative: the only light is a thin blazing strip under a door, feathering up the floor in honest penumbra. At hash-scheduled intervals a passer-by crosses the lit hallway, two soft footstep lobes dimming and splitting the spill.

params.label: Gap height
params.effect: CSS-pixel thickness of the lit gap under the door.

params.label: Spill reach
params.effect: How far the light feathers up into the room, as a fraction of frame height.

params.label: Pass rate
params.effect: How often a form crosses the hallway, from rare lone visits to restless pacing.

params.label: Flicker
params.effect: Depth of the strip's slow brightness breathing; eased and gentle, never a strobe.
